_comment: The payments package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.5). They name only its own types
and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every row is narrowed by FinanceAccess
(the seller's Owners, Admins and finance members; Spark:Commerce:Payments:PlatformOrganizationId's for every row), so
the rights alone show nothing. Nothing is written by a form: only QueryRead and the custom actions are granted.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-payments": false }.
